title: Finite-Sample Theory for Fitted Q-Iteration When Actions Are Functions
summary: Offline reinforcement learning seeks optimal decision rules from previously collected data. In some applications, a decision can be an entire function, such as a fluence map in radiation therapy or a smooth movement trajectory in robotics. In this paper, we study the finite-sample theory for fitted Q-iteration (FQI) with functional actions in a discounted infinite-horizon setting.
